long_biography.plain_text:
Fashion Yachts began as a yacht-services and brokerage company in 2001. Politi moved from sourcing boats into production, bringing in a property-investor partner and acquiring a Pisa shipyard in 2007. The business built composite and metal products across an expanding range, while the Politi Navi brand targeted a custom yacht programme between 35 and 85 metres.

SixthContinent shifted Politi's work from factory production to digital commerce. The platform linked consumers, merchants and gift-card purchases through a credit-back model intended to share part of transaction value among users. It also drew on his earlier work in information technology, combining retail transactions, software and consumer rewards in a single operating model.
long_biography.html:
Fashion Yachts began as a yacht-services and brokerage company in 2001. Politi moved from sourcing boats into production, bringing in a property-investor partner and acquiring a Pisa shipyard in 2007. The business built composite and metal products across an expanding range, while the Politi Navi brand targeted a custom yacht programme between 35 and 85 metres.

SixthContinent shifted Politi's work from factory production to digital commerce. The platform linked consumers, merchants and gift-card purchases through a credit-back model intended to share part of transaction value among users. It also drew on his earlier work in information technology, combining retail transactions, software and consumer rewards in a single operating model.

uncertainties: The common Italian name produces numerous namesakes, including a constitutional-law professor, a graphic designer and other professionals. The source-record nationality and yacht relationship were used only to select the founder of Fashion Yachts; the public biography then relies entirely on independent business and corporate sources.

Current public evidence does not disclose Politi's asset mix or the relative value of his technology, finance, art and cinema activities. Manufacturing is retained as Primary Industry only through the required origin-sector fallback, not as a claim about current dominant holdings.

Fashion Yachts reached material reported revenue and production scale, but sources do not disclose Politi's personal proceeds from the 2010 sale. The Manufacturing classification describes the best-evidenced wealth-creation platform rather than a quantified personal fortune.

A professional profile and IMDb give 1 September 1972, while Companies House independently confirms September 1972 and Wired confirms Milan in 1972. Low-quality self-published pages that instead say Livorno in 1973 were rejected because they conflict with stronger corporate and news evidence.
Companies House and LinkedIn place Politi in Luxembourg, but the source owner record retains Italy as the main residence. Luxembourg is therefore proposed only as a secondary residence country.

SixthContinent later faced regulatory sanctions and its UK entity is dissolved. Those facts inform the conservative current-industry classification but are excluded from the concise career biographies because the task did not request an adverse-media or insolvency profile.
